cohort: 2756 singleton pregnancies complicated with PPROM in 39 hospitals in China between January 1st, 2011 to December 31st, 2011
finding: After multivariable adjustment and stratification for gestational age, only pneumonia was significantly related with CS in the 28 to 34 weeks group.
mod_finding: While the proportion of cesarean section was high, mode of delivery did not affect most neonatal outcomes of pregnancies complicated with PPROM.
